author: TheMangyMoose
body:
Hello,

My minecraft username is Epic_G_101

I was banned for Hacking Aimbot on December 19, 2014.  I'm not sure why I was banned since I wasn't hacking - but I have been banned now for over 6 months and would really appreciate having the punishment lifted.  Avicus is my favorite server and I miss being able to play with my friends.  

Thank you very much for your consideration.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello Epic.

I have decided to lift your punishment but be warned. This chance is your last.

Please read up on the rules to ensure you gain no more infractions.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram
